notes.title: Axial Disc 2 Available Now!
notes.notes:
Axial Disc 2 is now available! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956680/Axial_Disc_2/]Get it here![/url]

Before beginning Axial Disc 2, it's recommended you transfer a save file from Axial Disc 1! Here's what we recommend!

1. Beat the game. You can only transfer save files that have completed the main story in Axial Disc 1.

2. Collect every summon. Summons are very powerful types of skills that will give you an edge in Axial Disc 2's later content!

3. Power up your party. Make sure your whole party is at the level you want them to be before you transfer! You'll be able to level up and use stat boosting coffee eventually in Disc 2, but getting ahead of the curve will save you time in the long run!

4. Collect Eater Eyes. Eater Eyes will be carried over and can be used on Disc 2's new party members alongside Amara after she returns! Stock up a lot of Eater Eyes for an advantage early on!


Enjoy the grand finale in Axial Disc 2!

notes.title: Patch 2.0.0 - Finest Mix
notes.notes:
"The Line has shifted 0.6.5 positions to the left..."

It's finally time for Axial Disc 1's latest patch: 2.0.0! This patch is so big, we've given it a name. This is Axial Disc 1: Finest Mix!

New features include...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40796301/1348b39f3611d203ce0fde56c8957d70ae95a316.png[/img]
By pressing the I key, you can open up a quick menu that allows you to access your Tools right in the overworld! Use it to explore the world more smoothly! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40796301/d57b3b7943435b91f7c711d7ed0eb19d06968e71.png[/img]
By pressing the O key, you can be reminded of your current objective in the story without having to report back to Dingo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40796301/d956b8a0eebcc5bb6a9332a7ab716a1e56235024.png[/img]
Presets for your Commands can now be saved and loaded, allowing you to swiftly change between three different presets at any time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40796301/9f83cbdecfa71b809920f1fb4c1e6a52f6430fd8.png[/img]
After a certain point in the story, speaking to the Infomaniac in Markton will allow you to receive hints on the locations of a certain Lion...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40796301/da82761d0a8942977515424ff04f1f9eae0d8eeb.png[/img]
Scenes have been reworked with improved writing and story beats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40796301/58ffcbe1dd8ee948362b5609046b3b77fa9483c1.png[/img]
Bluewood Forest has been completely reworked from the ground up to provide a smoother play experience!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40796301/586531ecf0f84c83c8eba92844c8b43ce5447469.png[/img]
The difficulty systems have also been reworked to provide more options for players of different skill levels! Those who completed Disc 1 on the Explorer difficulty will find an enhanced challenge in the Spinel difficulty!



Axial Disc 1: Finest Mix will become available for download on May 20th, 2022!

notes.title: Patch 1.2.6; Welcome to the Future!
notes.notes:
Hello hello! Patch 1.2.6 of Disc 1 is now LIVE! Here's what that means for Axial!

Firstly, the three major changes for this patch are as follows:
-We've fixed the "pointer bug" that causes a target to become the only selectable if the pointer is hovering over them (if you were having trouble only targeting Sai, this is probably fixed!)
-The "NWJS Error" appearing for some players when launching the game should be removed. This is something that is difficult to test for the developers, so if this messages persists, please let us know!
-Finally, we have made a small tweak to Achievements. If, for whatever reason, you lost an achievement or didn't receive it when you were supposed to, you can now return to the location that you would have gotten the achievement in and have it awarded to you once more!

Along with these changes, here are other recent changes you may have missed!
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FBEuMuvWYAEcskx?format=png&name=large[/img]
You can now return to the locations of certain encounters after beating the game to relive those fights under their original conditions!

An Impact Flash option has been added as well, allowing you to toggle the flashing effects that appear on several animations in the game!

Small bug fixes and balancing changes have also been periodically added, and more changes could be made in the future! Look forward to it!

-Sawyer Friend
